Beyond DT120, we believe DT402 represents an exciting opportunity and its initial results support continued development as we work to deliver differentiated therapies for patients with significant unmet needs.” Third Quarter and Recent Highlights ▪ DT120 ODT in GAD: Reported positive topline results from Phase 3 Voyage study in GAD with 214 participants randomized 1:1 to receive DT120 ODT 100 µg or placebo.

Key findings included: o Met the primary endpoint and all key secondary efficacy endpoints with a high degree of statistical significance. o Demonstrated a statistically significant and clinically meaningful placebo-adjusted improvement of 5.4 points in Hamilton Anxiety Rating Scale (HAM-A) total score from baseline at Week 12 (p<0.0001, Cohen’s d=0.81), the study’s primary endpoint. o DT120 ODT was generally well tolerated, with no drug-related serious adverse events and no suicidality signal observed in Part A. ▪ DT120 ODT in GAD: Reported positive topline results from Phase 3 Panorama study in GAD with 245 participants randomized 2:1:2 to receive DT120 ODT 100 µg, DT120 ODT 50 µg control, or placebo.

Key findings included: o Met the primary endpoint and all key secondary efficacy endpoints with a high degree of statistical significance. 1 o Demonstrated a statistically significant and clinically meaningful placebo-adjusted improvement of 5.1 points in HAM-A total score from baseline at Week 12 (p<0.0001, Cohen’s d=0.64), the study’s primary endpoint. o DT120 ODT was generally well tolerated, with no drug-related serious adverse events and no suicidality signal observed in Part A. ▪ DT120 ODT in MDD: o Received Breakthrough Therapy designation for DT120 ODT in MDD following positive topline results from Phase 3 Emerge study, which met the primary endpoint and all key secondary efficacy endpoints with a high degree of statistical significance. o Continuing enrollment for the Phase 3 Ascend study in MDD.

Topline data is expected in 2027. ▪ DT120 ODT in PTSD: Planning to initiate the Phase 3 Haven study in PTSD in 2027 with approximately 200 participants randomized 1:1 to receive DT120 ODT 100 µg or placebo.

Presentations included topline results from the Phase 3 Emerge, Voyage and Panorama studies of DT120 ODT, an overview of the DT120 ODT Phase 3 safety data, and the DT120 ODT Phase 3 development program.
